purpose: Adventure review image cleanup; alpha-only edits, no content regeneration
naming_note: The extracted basenames place the cream line illustration at image1, the app screenshot at image9, and the website screenshot at image10; processing follows those actual source files.
coverage_limitations: Opaque source RGB pixels are preserved exactly; transparent edges use hard, deterministic edge-connected masks and may retain a small source-colored matte on anti-aliased artwork.
Intentional white interiors of cards and device screens are protected with barriers, so some interior white remains opaque by design.
image4 and image5 are intentionally unchanged because their navy/orange teaching-panel fills reach the image edges.

image1.png.method: edge-connected warm-cream flood fill; artwork pixels retained
image1.png.notes: Cream outside the illustrated navy/orange linework is transparent.

image2.jpg.method: edge-connected near-white flood fill; original JPEG pixels retained
image2.jpg.notes: Output is PNG so the white page around both colored diagrams can be transparent.

image3.png.method: edge-connected near-white flood fill with three card-interior barriers
image3.png.notes: White card interiors remain opaque so lettering and panel backgrounds are preserved.

image4.png.method: copied as RGBA with fully opaque alpha
image4.png.notes: Intentional Exhale/Inhale navy and orange teaching panel reaches the image edges.

image5.png.method: copied as RGBA with fully opaque alpha
image5.png.notes: Intentional navy fruit-of-the-Spirit teaching panel reaches the image edges.

image6.png.method: edge-connected near-white flood fill around the faucet diagram
image6.png.notes: Black labels, faucet imagery, water, and sink remain untouched.

image7.png.method: edge-connected near-white flood fill with diagram-panel barrier
image7.png.notes: The white interior of the five-ways diagram remains opaque.

image8.png.notes: Navy/orange people, connection lines, and enclosed light interiors are retained.

image9.png.method: edge-connected near-white/gray flood fill with five phone-screen barriers
image9.png.notes: Phone screens and their lettering stay opaque; outer white/grid page becomes transparent.

image10.png.method: edge-connected near-white flood fill outside screenshot bounds
image10.png.notes: Website screenshot and reflection are preserved; only safely isolated outer white is transparent.
